verdict.rationale: Folk, a CRM SaaS, has its own documented MCP offering. Its help center has a dedicated MCP collection covering use with Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, and agent tasks such as logging calls, bulk record updates, plain-language relationship search and contact imports. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented there. However, the evidence is only use-case article titles. It does not show how an agent actually connects, so coverage is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: connection/setup documentation (server endpoint or install method), the authentication flow for agents, a list of exposed tools and permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
